ipv4_enabled.description: Whether to enable IPv4 DHCP. Disable only if using IPv6 only or static IPv4.

ipv6_enabled.description: Whether to enable IPv6 address autoconfiguration (SLAAC) and DHCPv6.

hostname.description: Hostname to advertise to the DHCP server. If empty, the system hostname is used.

domain.description: Domain name to request from the DHCP server (e.g., 'example.com').

dns_servers.description: Additional DNS server IP addresses to append (beyond those provided by DHCP).

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of a DNS server.

static_interfaces.description: List of interfaces with static IP configuration instead of DHCP.

routers.description: List of gateway/router addresses for this interface.

dns.description: List of DNS server addresses to use on this interface.

custom_options.description: Arbitrary key-value options passed directly to dhcpcd (e.g., 'blacklist', 'permit', 'nohook').

ntp_servers.description: List of NTP server addresses to configure for time synchronization.

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of an NTP server.

nis_domain.description: NIS (YP) domain name to request from the DHCP server.

nis_servers.description: List of NIS server addresses to request from the DHCP server.

nisplus_domain.description: NIS+ domain name to request from the DHCP server.

nisplus_servers.description: List of NIS+ server addresses to request.

request_options.description: Custom DHCP options to request (by numeric option code, e.g., '121' for classless static routes).

items.description: Human-readable description of the option (for comment only; not used by dhcpcd).

retry_count.description: Number of times to retry DHCP acquisition before giving up.

hooks_to_skip.description: List of dhcpcd hook scripts to skip (e.g., ['hostname', 'ntp']).
